description: This file defines classes and constants related to AT-SPI device events, including event types, modifiers, and event handling classes, for accessibility event processing.

classes.name: PressedEventType
classes.description: Enumeration for pressed and released key/button events.

classes.name: ControllerEventMask
classes.description: Enumeration for event masks for key and button events.

classes.name: KeyEventType
classes.description: Enumeration for key press and release types.

classes.name: KeySynthType
classes.description: Enumeration for different key synthesis types.

classes.name: DeviceEvent
classes.description: Class wrapping an AT-SPI device event with additional attributes and string representation.

classes.name: EventListenerMode
classes.description: Class representing event listener modes with properties for synchronization, preemptive, and global flags.

classes.name: KeyDefinition
classes.description: Class representing a key definition with properties for keycode, keysym, keystring, and unused.

methods.name: allModifiers
methods.description: Generator function that yields all possible keyboard modifier masks.
